This break from the pressures of work and everyday life can lead to improved mental health, increased happiness, and a renewed sense of energy and perspective upon returning home. By stepping away from familiar environments and responsibilities, people can gain clarity, reduce stress, and return to their daily lives with a refreshed outlook and increased productivity.
